sql.label: 035 namespaces: each institution's own top 12, unioned
sql.sql:
WITH ns AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id, upper(trim(regexp_extract(value, '^\s*\(([^)]{1,24})\)', 1))) AS prefix
  FROM records
  WHERE field_tag = '035' AND subfield_code = 'a'
),
per AS (
  SELECT org, prefix, count(DISTINCT pod_record_id) AS n
  FROM ns
  WHERE prefix <> ''
  GROUP BY org, prefix
),
sized AS (
  SELECT p.*, r.records
  FROM per p
  JOIN (SELECT org, count(*) AS records FROM record_meta GROUP BY org) r USING (org)
),
picked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prefix
  FROM sized
  WHERE n >= records * 0.001
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY org ORDER BY n DESC, prefix) <= 12
)
SELECT p.org, p.prefix AS category, p.n
FROM per p
WHERE p.prefix IN (SELECT prefix FROM picked)

sql.label: Share denominator: all records
sql.sql: SELECT org, count(*) AS n FROM record_meta GROUP BY org

sql.label: Records carrying each channel's system number
sql.sql:
WITH ns AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id, upper(trim(regexp_extract(value, '^\s*\(([^)]{1,24})\)', 1))) AS prefix
  FROM records
  WHERE field_tag = '035' AND subfield_code = 'a'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id,
         bool_or(prefix LIKE 'OCOLC%') AS oclc,
         bool_or(prefix = 'CSTRLIN') AS rlin,
         bool_or(prefix IN ('EXLCZ', 'CKB')) AS alma_cz,
         bool_or(CASE
         WHEN prefix = 'RPB'
              OR prefix LIKE 'RPB-%'
              OR prefix = 'RBN'
              OR prefix = 'RPJCB'
              THEN 'brown'
         WHEN prefix = 'NCD'
              OR prefix LIKE 'NCD-%'
              OR prefix = 'NDD'
              THEN 'duke'
         WHEN prefix = 'MH'
              OR prefix LIKE 'MH-%'
              OR prefix = 'HLS'
              OR prefix = 'HUL'
              OR prefix = 'HMS'
              OR prefix = 'HBS'
              OR prefix = 'DDO'
              OR prefix = 'HVL'
              OR prefix = 'HHG'
              OR prefix = 'HMY'
              OR prefix = 'HMZ'
              OR prefix = 'HMG'
              OR prefix = 'HTV'
              OR prefix = 'HMU'
              OR prefix = 'HFL'
              THEN 'harvard'
         WHEN prefix = 'PU'
              OR prefix LIKE 'PU-%'
              OR prefix = 'PAU'
              THEN 'penn'
         WHEN prefix = 'NJP'
              OR prefix LIKE 'NJP-%'
              OR prefix = 'PUL'
              OR prefix = 'PULEA'
              THEN 'princeton'
         WHEN prefix = 'CST'
              OR prefix LIKE 'CST-%'
              OR prefix = 'STF'
              THEN 'stanford'
         END = org OR prefix IN ('SIRSI', 'PUVOYAGERBIBID')) AS local_system,
         bool_or(CASE
         WHEN prefix = 'RPB'
              OR prefix LIKE 'RPB-%'
              OR prefix = 'RBN'
              OR prefix = 'RPJCB'
              THEN 'brown'
         WHEN prefix = 'NCD'
              OR prefix LIKE 'NCD-%'
              OR prefix = 'NDD'
              THEN 'duke'
         WHEN prefix = 'MH'
              OR prefix LIKE 'MH-%'
              OR prefix = 'HLS'
              OR prefix = 'HUL'
              OR prefix = 'HMS'
              OR prefix = 'HBS'
              OR prefix = 'DDO'
              OR prefix = 'HVL'
              OR prefix = 'HHG'
              OR prefix = 'HMY'
              OR prefix = 'HMZ'
              OR prefix = 'HMG'
              OR prefix = 'HTV'
              OR prefix = 'HMU'
              OR prefix = 'HFL'
              THEN 'harvard'
         WHEN prefix = 'PU'
              OR prefix LIKE 'PU-%'
              OR prefix = 'PAU'
              THEN 'penn'
         WHEN prefix = 'NJP'
              OR prefix LIKE 'NJP-%'
              OR prefix = 'PUL'
              OR prefix = 'PULEA'
              THEN 'princeton'
         WHEN prefix = 'CST'
              OR prefix LIKE 'CST-%'
              OR prefix = 'STF'
              THEN 'stanford'
         END IS NOT NULL AND CASE
         WHEN prefix = 'RPB'
              OR prefix LIKE 'RPB-%'
              OR prefix = 'RBN'
              OR prefix = 'RPJCB'
              THEN 'brown'
         WHEN prefix = 'NCD'
              OR prefix LIKE 'NCD-%'
              OR prefix = 'NDD'
              THEN 'duke'
         WHEN prefix = 'MH'
              OR prefix LIKE 'MH-%'
              OR prefix = 'HLS'
              OR prefix = 'HUL'
              OR prefix = 'HMS'
              OR prefix = 'HBS'
              OR prefix = 'DDO'
              OR prefix = 'HVL'
              OR prefix = 'HHG'
              OR prefix = 'HMY'
              OR prefix = 'HMZ'
              OR prefix = 'HMG'
              OR prefix = 'HTV'
              OR prefix = 'HMU'
              OR prefix = 'HFL'
              THEN 'harvard'
         WHEN prefix = 'PU'
              OR prefix LIKE 'PU-%'
              OR prefix = 'PAU'
              THEN 'penn'
         WHEN prefix = 'NJP'
              OR prefix LIKE 'NJP-%'
              OR prefix = 'PUL'
              OR prefix = 'PULEA'
              THEN 'princeton'
         WHEN prefix = 'CST'
              OR prefix LIKE 'CST-%'
              OR prefix = 'STF'
              THEN 'stanford'
         END <> org) AS pod_system,
         bool_or(prefix <> '') AS any_system
  FROM ns
  GROUP BY org, pod_record_id
),
counted AS (
  SELECT org,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE oclc) AS oclc,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE rlin) AS rlin,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE alma_cz) AS alma_cz,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE local_system) AS local_system,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE pod_system) AS pod_system,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE any_system) AS any_system
  FROM flagged GROUP BY org
),
totals AS (SELECT org, count(*) AS records FROM record_meta GROUP BY org)
SELECT t.org, t.records,
       coalesce(c.oclc, 0) AS oclc,
       coalesce(c.rlin, 0) AS rlin,
       coalesce(c.alma_cz, 0) AS alma_cz,
       coalesce(c.local_system, 0) AS local_system,
       coalesce(c.pod_system, 0) AS pod_system,
       coalesce(c.any_system, 0) AS any_system
FROM totals t LEFT JOIN counted c USING (org)
ORDER BY t.org
